verdict.rationale: Bruno doesn't offer a cloud region/residency picker because it has no cloud storage at all — collections live only on the user's local filesystem, with no account, no cloud sync, and 'zero visibility' into requests. This satisfies the underlying intent (user fully controls where data physically resides) but there's no explicit residency/region configuration feature, e.g. for team/enterprise cloud storage. Missing for 10: an explicit region-selection setting, any cloud-hosted storage option with region controls, or enterprise data-residency documentation.
